task_instance: Create a minimal Node.js project, install @huggingface/transformers, and run the pipeline API example from the skill doc (pipeline('sentiment-analysis') on sample text, verifying real inference output, then dispose()).
blocker_detail: npm install @huggingface/transformers succeeded (with --ignore-scripts to skip onnxruntime-node's optional CUDA-binary postinstall step, whose network call to a non-allowlisted host caused an ECONNRESET; the bundled linux/x64 CPU binary was already present so this was harmless). The pipeline API code itself loaded and ran correctly, but pipeline('sentiment-analysis') needs to fetch the model's config/weights from huggingface.co (Xenova/distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english). Direct curl and the Node fetch both got 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' / 'Forbidden access to file' because the sandbox's outbound proxy policy denies huggingface.co (it is not in the proxy's no-proxy allowlist, which only covers npm/pypi/crates/etc.). No local/offline model files are available to substitute, so no model could actually be downloaded and run, meaning the skill's core deliverable (running a real ML model via Transformers.js) could not be completed end-to-end.
evidence: Commands run in /tmp/.../huggingface__skills__transformers-js: `npm install @huggingface/transformers --ignore-scripts` succeeded (46 packages). Wrote test.mjs using `import { pipeline } from '@huggingface/transformers'; const pipe = await pipeline('sentiment-analysis'); ...`. Running `node test.mjs` threw `ModelFileNotFoundError: Forbidden access to file: https://huggingface.co/Xenova/distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english/resolve/main/config.json` with status 403. Confirmed independently with `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://huggingface.co/.../config.json` which returned agent-proxy error: 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403 ... connect_rejected (the egress proxy denied the CONNECT (organization policy))'. Checked `curl $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status` and confirmed huggingface.co is not in the proxy's noProxy allowlist (only registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org, crates.io, etc. are allowed). Files produced: package.json, node_modules/ (installed), test.mjs.
